item.description: Pydantic forward reference errors in artifact serialization. Multiple test cases are failing with "field "loads" not yet prepared so type is still a ForwardRef, you might need to call Artifact.update_forward_refs()" errors.
item.contract: Fix Pydantic forward reference issues by ensuring that Artifact classes properly call update_forward_refs() after class definition to resolve forward references in the loads field.

item.description: Missing file path handling in artifact loading causing FileNotFoundError exceptions. Several tests are failing with "FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory" errors when trying to load artifacts.
item.contract: Ensure artifact loading properly handles file paths by validating that artifact paths exist before attempting to load them, and implement proper fallback behavior for missing files.
